params.promptTemplate: Plan a gentle three-chapter bedtime story for a {reader_age}-year-old about {topic}: a title, the name of any character who appears in more than one chapter, then one line per chapter.
Using this plan: {{outline}} Write chapter 1 for a {reader_age}-year-old. Start with the book's own title as a '# ' heading, then '## Chapter 1'. A few short, kind paragraphs.
Using this plan: {{outline}} Write chapter 2 for a {reader_age}-year-old. Start with '## Chapter 2'. A few short, kind paragraphs.
Using this plan: {{outline}} Write chapter 3 for a {reader_age}-year-old. Start with '## Chapter 3'. A few short, kind paragraphs, ending on a comforting, sleepy note.
